title: One Grumpy Cat Almost Ruins Everything — Part 2

series.summary: The rescue team's stealth mission nearly collapses when the mansion's pet cat bolts and walks straight into a guard's flashlight, before Nano picks the lock and the team slips inside.

segments.voiceover_text: The plan almost dies immediately — the mansion's cat bolts, and Karane faceplants chasing it. Worse, the cat strolls straight into a guard's flashlight. But he just crouches down to pet it, completely fooled. The team slips past the hedges, hearts pounding.

Deeper in the grounds, Nano spreads her arms as a human shield while the others huddle in the bushes. At the mansion door, her lockpick turns the deadbolt — open. Inside the dark hallway, Rentarou gently takes her hand. A quiet promise: nobody gets left behind tonight. They have no idea the mansion's deadliest guard walks on four legs.
